description: Ask for a payout of the developer's payable balance (capability income only — topped-up money cannot be withdrawn). Call it once without `confirmed` to get the estimate (amount, channel fee, withholding tax, what actually lands), show that to the user, and only then call again with confirmed: true. Needs the developer's Qumge key.

amount_usd.description: How much to withdraw, in US dollars.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user has seen the estimate and agreed.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: request_payout
